parameters.name: All
parameters.description: Specifies whether to detach all tags from the resource. This parameter takes effect when TagKey.N is empty. The default value is **false**.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The IDs of resources from which you want to detach tags.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Enumeration type, currently supported resource types:

- **INSTANCE**

- **TOPIC**

- **CONSUMERGROUP**

> Case-insensitive.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag keys of the resource.
